name: meta-muse-spark
description: Meta Muse Spark chat models via the Meta AI API (OpenAI-compatible). Bring your own Meta AI API key.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Meta AI API Key
x-meta.help: Your Meta AI API key. Leave empty to fall back to the META_MODEL_API_KEY environment variable.

x-meta.label: Default Model
x-meta.help: A Meta AI model id. Empty uses muse-spark-1.1.

x-meta.label: Base URL
x-meta.help: Optional override of the Meta AI base URL. Empty uses https://api.meta.ai/v1.
